description: Independent source-evidence and linguistic editorial review tasks for the 40 new A2–C1 drafts; these tasks are NOT completed checks.

english_definition_review.task: Compare this exact sense and part of speech with a trustworthy learner dictionary; note source, access date and any disagreement.

burmese_review.task: Ask a competent Burmese editor to assess meaning, register and naturalness against the verified English sense.

example_review.task: Check natural grammar, collocation and exact sense; revise if needed.

cefr_review.task: Check CEFR for the specific sense, not word frequency or another part of speech; quarantine or reclassify conflicts.

audio_review.task: After text approval, generate and listen-check British George and Emma recordings on actual playback devices.
